```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7,
                      fig.height = 4, dpi = 110)
```

```{r}
library(svid)
```

Index discovery is not restricted to classification or to four bands. Here the
target is leaf area index and the sensor carries shortwave infrared.

```{r}
sim <- svid_simulate(n = 200, sensor = "landsat8", epochs = 5,
                     response = "lai", seed = 3)
sim
svid_bands(sensor = "landsat8")
```

```{r}
pool <- svid_prune(svid_generate(svid_grammar(c("G", "R", "N", "S1", "S2"),
                                              max_depth = 1)), sim)
pool
```

```{r}
sc <- svid_separability(pool, sim)   # Spearman for regression targets
head(sc, 5)
```

```{r}
fit <- svid_regress(svid_shortlist(sc, 6), sim, n_seeds = 2,
                    baselines = c("raw_bands", "ndvi"))
fit
```

## Portability to another platform

```{r}
svid_cross_sensor(head(as.character(pool), 5),
                  from = "landsat8", to = "sentinel2")
```

## Robustness to radiometric error

```{r}
svid_perturb(head(as.character(pool), 6), sim, n_rep = 5)
```

## Physically based screening

With `ccrtm` or `hsdar` installed, `svid_prosail()` ranks indices by their
sensitivity to a target biophysical variable relative to their contamination by
confounders such as soil brightness.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
svid_prosail(head(as.character(pool), 20), target = "LAI",
             confounders = c("psoil", "Cab"), n = 300, sensor = "landsat8")
```
